compact/posix/windsurf/ollama-embed/deep.html: # Keep generated configuration files out of version control. echo .chunkhound.json >> .gitignore # Configure ChunkHound with Ollama embeddings and DeepSeek for research. Embedding and LLM providers are independent — either works without the other. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/ # You'll need: DeepSeek API key cat > .chunkhound.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' { "embedding": { "provider": "openai", "model": "qwen3-embedding", "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1" }, "llm": { "provider": "deepseek", "model": "deepseek-v4-flash", "api_key": "<YOUR_DEEPSEEK_API_KEY>" } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF # Configure Windsurf to connect to ChunkHound via MCP. if [ -f ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json ]; then cat <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json already exists — merge this block into it manually: { "mcpServers": { "ChunkHound": { "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF else mkdir -p ~/.codeium/windsurf cat > ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' { "mcpServers": { "ChunkHound": { "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF fi # Build ChunkHound's search index for this project. chunkhound index .
